presentation: Selected historical cases, not actual past alert delivery or a strategy backtest.
basis: Unadjusted USD daily closes, except explicitly labeled intraday lows. Price change = end close / base close - 1. Dividends, fees and taxes excluded. Dates are market sessions; closes are not event-time executable prices. All daily points, including losses and same-session SPY comparisons, are retained.

rsi_example.basis: Recomputed from closes through that price date, not a stored historical indicator snapshot.
